blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senators Risa Hontiveros and Pia Cayetano locked horns anew on Monday over an alleged attempt to close the period of amendments to the proposed expanded anti-online child sexual abuse bill despite a list of revisions that the latter still wanted to introduce. As Hontiveros was about to read on the Senate floor Cayetano’s amendments to the measure, the latter stood up to ask about her colleague’s supposed plan to close the period of amendments last week. “Your Honor knows that we have amendments, right?” Cayetano began. “So I was surprised that you ordered the closure last week, because […]...
